verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies data control. The hybrid architecture keeps the control plane out of the data path, so by default it doesn't see LLM traffic. Logs are written to a local, user-controlled path (/usr/local/kong/logs/error.log or the Docker container), and DLP policies can strip PII before data flows on. Logs can also capture full request and response payloads, and no retention or deletion settings are documented. Missing for 10: configurable log and payload retention periods, documented deletion/purge mechanisms (including for Konnect analytics and semantic cache data), toggles to disable payload logging, and any independent corroboration.
